title: Advocacy of Christ
definition: The advocacy of Christ is His gracious work as the righteous representative who pleads for believers when they sin.
summary: Jesus is the Advocate for believers before the Father.
christFocus: Christ's advocacy rests on His righteousness and atoning sacrifice.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christ's advocacy addresses the believer's ongoing need for grace. When believers sin, they do not have to hide in despair. They have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

His advocacy is not based on excuses for sin. It is based on His righteousness and atoning sacrifice.

This doctrine gives confidence without encouraging carelessness. The Advocate who defends also calls His people to walk in the light.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers can either minimize sin or drown in shame after failure. The advocacy of Christ matters because it points them back to the righteous Savior.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Confess sin quickly and honestly. Do not let shame keep you from the Father. Trust your Advocate and walk again in the light.
